description: This file defines authentication API endpoints in a FastAPI application, including user registration and login, handling JWT token creation and user credential validation.

methods.name: TokenOut register(payload: RegisterIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user record and returning a JWT access token.

methods.name: TokenOut login(payload: LoginIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user login by validating credentials and returning a JWT access token.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenOut:$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^def register(payload: RegisterIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenOut:$/
